prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Practice Controlling Your Companion", "Try out your hotkeys right now on your desktop to summon, hide, or interact with your pet.", "Start Using Pet", "Press Alt+P to toggle desktop pet visibility", "Hotkey Ready"]
1: ["Official Companion Adoption", "Give your new desktop pet a permanent name to seal the adoption.", "Complete Adoption", "Companion Name"]
2: ["Your Companion is Ready on Desktop", "Follow these quick steps to interact with your pet on your screen.", "Launch Pet", "1. Click pet to open context menu | 2. Drag to move anywhere on screen"]
3: ["Generating Your Unique Desktop Pet", "We are crafting your pet's visuals and desktop behaviors. Hang tight!"]
4: ["Signing in automatically restores your previously adopted pets and cloud saves."]
5: ["Control Your Pet Anytime with Hotkeys", "Use Alt+P to toggle pet visibility or Right-Click your pet on the desktop for quick actions and settings."]
6: ["You can safely minimize this window. We will notify you when your pet is ready!"]
7: []
8: []
9: ["Includes Bonus Trait Pack"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions a bonus or free extra
